title: Bony Overlap Following Use of the Inferior Border Saw for the 'Low and Short' Sagittal Split: A Split-Mouth Study
official: Evaluate How Use of an Inferior Border Saw While Making the Inferior Border Osteotomy During Sagittal Ramus Osteotomy Using the Low and Short Medial Osteotomy Modification Technique Affects the Lingual Fracture Pattern of the Mandible
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate if use of an inferior border saw while making the inferior border osteotomy is associated with the medial cortex fracture pattern.

interventions.name: Inferior Osteotomy made by border saw
Inferior Osteotomy made with reciprocating saw

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patient's having mandible surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe dentofacial deformity secondary to a syndromic diagnosis
